TC-10/S08.title: AI Check: 10 dictations with no vitals, labs or tests (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10
TC-10/S08.detail: Not run. It is an AI check of parsePreRoundNotes itself (lane B, runner 'preround-ai'): it needs a live model, so it can only be judged on dev, and the runner the matrix describes (build the app's patient / background context, call ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes, apply the exported guards, score 9/10) is not built (matrix runnerGap); no dev unit or dataset exists for it. The same requirement (U9 / AC 7) is judged through the real Save Note on two dictations by TC-10/S30 (local app handling: passed; dev: see results.pre.json in runs/2026-10-14-dev).
